Tests pass 'turnstile_token': 'test-bypass-token'. Frontend testing: login at /auth (data-testid auth-input-email/auth-input-password, click 'SE CONNECTER' text — button is NOT type=submit). Token stored in localStorage under key 'cc_access_token'. Drag-drop in ServerRail uses @dnd-kit and triggers folder creation when a server is dropped onto another (verified working).
rca of the issue: Root cause: FastAPI matched GET /api/servers/unread as /api/servers/{server_id} because the parameterized route was declared first; the unread endpoint then ran require_membership on server_id='unread' and rejected with 403. Frontend polled this every 30s, leading to repeated failures and, in some flows, a state-update loop that froze the UI. Fix verified: /api/servers/unread now defined at line 907 (BEFORE /servers/{server_id} at line 940). Test test_servers_unread_returns_200_for_admin and test_servers_unread_returns_200_for_new_user both 200 OK. Frontend run shows 0 403s on /api/servers/unread.
